description: Put something on a trip as stops. source says what: stops (plain stops you describe in stops), saved_places (library places with their pins, photos and links; by savedPlaceIds, folderName, or importId for everything an import found), search_result (one option from search_stays, search_activities or search_places by resultId + optionId), flight (a fare from search_flights by searchId + offerId), train (a fare from search_trains by searchId + journeyId), receipt (a booking confirmation as text or base64 image/PDF; parsed, filed on the trip, and the matching stop marked booked). Say which day with dayIndex or date; a stay defaults to its check-in date, a flight or train to its departure day. These are plans, not bookings: the traveler books through each stop's bookingUrl. Returns data plus display.resultId; call display_card to show it. presentation (optional) shapes what is shown without changing the action: compact or full layout, and only the limit, ids or sections this tool advertises.

contentType.description: (source=receipt) Type of the base64 bytes in data

data.description: (source=receipt) Raw base64 bytes of the image or PDF, no data URL prefix

date.description: The day's calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) instead of dayIndex

dayIndex.description: 0-based day for the stop (stops carry their own); or give date instead

folderName.description: (source=saved_places) Every place in this library folder

importId.description: (source=saved_places) Everything an import found; the import's own day hints place each stop

journeyId.description: (source=train) The journey's id from that search

kind.description: (source=search_result) What the option is, for legacy object callers. stay = a search_stays property. activity = a search_activities product. place = a search_places result's itemDraft. Restored from resultId when you pass one.

offerId.description: (source=flight) The fare's id from that search

option.description: (source=search_result) The option/offer object (or, for kind 'place', the itemDraft), unchanged

optionId.description: Exact propertyId (stay), productId (activity), or id (place) from that search reply

layout.description: Compact cards or the full view; keeps booking, add and error actions available.

resultId.description: The search reply's display.resultId; account-bound and retained for 30 minutes

searchId.description: (source=flight, train) The searchId returned by search_flights or search_trains

source.description: stops = plain stops described in `stops`; saved_places = library places by savedPlaceIds, folderName or importId, with pins, photos and links intact; search_result = one search option by resultId + optionId; flight = a search_flights fare by searchId + offerId; train = a search_trains fare by searchId + journeyId; receipt = a booking confirmation (text, or contentType + data) filed on the trip

spreadAcrossDays.description: (source=saved_places) Deal the places out across the trip's days in order instead of one day

stopId.description: (source=receipt) Link the confirmation to this stop and mark it booked

stops.description: (source=stops) Each stop names its day with dayIndex or date

cost.description: Estimated cost per person, MAJOR units (120 = $120)

costCurrency.description: ISO code for cost; defaults to the trip currency

description.description: Why it's worth it, tips, context

destination.description: Flights only: arrival airport IATA code (e.g. 'LIS')

origin.description: Flights only: departure airport IATA code (e.g. 'JFK'); gives the stop a live fare search link

time.description: Start time at the destination, 24h HH:MM

title.description: Name of the place or plan, e.g. 'Senso-ji Temple'

type.description: flight | train | transport | stay | activity | food | note

text.description: (source=receipt) The confirmation text; omit when sending image/PDF bytes

time.description: Start time at the destination, HH:MM (a stay's check-in time; saved_places: the first place of each day)

name: add_to_trip
title: Add to a trip
